ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: High-contrast ratio characterized by a dominant high-intensity white central field (~85%) surrounded by a low-intensity black peripheral margin (~15%).
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Large contiguous white geometric field across both lobes; thin black banding (approx. 5-15 pixel width) along the entire trailing edge; small, discrete low-intensity circular clusters (mottling) located on the distal-right and medial-left white surfaces.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Deep, narrow V-shaped central depression with a sharp vertex angle; depth extends significantly into the fluke body.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: Continuous high-frequency serrations with variable pixel-amplitude (1-5 pixels) along the trailing boundary; a sequence of larger irregular peaks is visible on the distal third of both lobes.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Convex curve fitted to the trailing edge, tapering to sharp points at the distal tips.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Detection of localized dark pixel clusters on the high-intensity white background of the right lobe distal region and lower medial left lobe region.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Faint vertical dark linear disruptions visible on the white surface directly adjacent to the central notch.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: A significant irregular indentation (notched tissue loss) on the outer trailing edge of the right distal tip, creating a secondary notch profile.
other_distinctive_markers: Presence of small isolated dark spots within the central white field of the right lobe that do not align with the peripheral banding.
